Backend Developer Wiki

This site is the developer-facing map of the AI4S-Bench backend. Treat the implementation and migrations as the ground truth for behavior; use these pages to find the relevant code, contracts, and operational constraints. Update the wiki in the same change when a behavior or interface changes.

Start here

  • Architecture: application composition, domain boundaries, persistence, background work, and API contract locations.
  • Runtime and Configuration: local startup, environment settings, runtime processes, and deployment notes.
  • AI Proposal Reviews: the benchmark repository's automated proposal review integration.

Ground-truth sources

Concern Source of truth
HTTP routes and request/response models src/**/routes.py, src/**/schemas.py, and generated OpenAPI schemas
Database schema and upgrades src/db/ and migrations/versions/
Runtime configuration src/core/config.py and .env.example
Execution and queue behavior src/control_panel/, src/jobs/, and src/community/
Automated behavior checks tests/

For setup commands and the broader repository layout, see backend/README.md.
